title: Existence of the normalized ringed Koszul Cech comparison

proof.text: 1. Construct a prescribed strict tensor-tower presentation and its unit-compatible Cech comparison on the site and independently on every slice.
2. Obtain the unit-normalized source completion restriction comparisons. Conjugate them by theta and slice theta to construct target restriction and further target restriction.
3. Reuse the existing completion_unit_natural theorem from ExtendedCechCompletionModel for the actual Cech unit. Transport that naturality equation through theta to prove strict-unit naturality.

4. Cancel the source completion unit, after postcomposing with the inverse comparison, to prove uniqueness of theta and all normalized restriction isomorphisms. To prove arbitrary comparison coherence, form its composite normalized candidate and use that uniqueness; specialize to the canonical further restriction isomorphism.

5. For the empty list the Cech unit is evaluation at one followed by a K-injective replacement, hence an isomorphism. Its composite with theta is the strict presentation unit. Assemble every field of RingedKoszulCechComparison.

proof_origin.note: Explicitly construct and transport the presentations; reuse the original completion-unit naturality theorem, prove all normalized uniqueness and arbitrary coherence, and prove the empty-list unit. The only new admitted parts are the prescribed-presentation Hom/limit calculation and idempotence of the actual completion-unit maps.
